description: Reviews agi-memory commands that rewrite the canonical memory vault, permanently delete a memory across every synced machine, attach a remote that will receive the whole store, bulk-seed it from git history, or change the invariants injected into later sessions. Reads such as recall, log, inspect, blocks and sync status stay unreviewed.
name: agi-memory command protection
saferAlternatives: Run agi-memory sync status or agi-memory blocks first to see what the destructive command would change.
